card.text: Race each other live on the same fresh puzzle: open a lobby, the others join, and 3, 2, 1, go!
card.none: No races yet. Open one and challenge the group!

page.missing_hint: The lobby may have expired or been called off, or it belongs to a group you're not in.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.text: Everyone who joins gets the same fresh puzzle at the same moment. The host starts once at least two have joined.
lobby.cancel_confirm: Call off the race? The lobby closes for everyone in it.
lobby.need_more: Waiting for at least one more player…
lobby.waiting_host: Waiting for the host to start…
lobby.expires: The lobby closes in {{ minutes }} min if nobody starts it.
lobby.share_text: Race me on Hashi! Join the lobby in {{ group }}:

play.give_up_confirm: Give up the race? You won't get a place, and you'll see the solution once the race is over.
play.loading: The puzzle is on its way…

track.title: Progress
track.text: How far everyone is: the share of the bridges on their board. Nobody sees anyone's bridges.

watch.text: You're watching: the race is on between the players.

done.waiting: Waiting for the others to finish…

results.title: Results
results.stage: The race's board with the bridges of {{ names }}
results.share_text: We raced this Hashi puzzle. Can you beat our times?
results.share_hint: Share the puzzle as a link: the racers' times are on its board as the ones to beat.

errors.open: There's a race open in this group already: join that one.
errors.gone: This race isn't here any more: the lobby expired or was called off.
errors.started: This race has started already: you can watch it.
errors.host_only: Only the host can start the race.
errors.too_few: A race needs at least two players.

shared.by_blocked: Shared puzzle · by a blocked player
shared.by_former: Shared puzzle · by a former player
shared.lobby: Everyone who joins gets this shared puzzle at the same moment. The host starts once at least two have joined.
